notes.title: Developer update #1 & #2
notes.content:
Hi! This is my first update here :) 
I am happy to report there are a lot going on in the development \o/

[h2]Devlog #1[/h2]

I created 4 maps for the game including a elevator. It will work to unload one level and load the next level so almost like a real elevator. It even displays the floor you are in and, when moving, the floor numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922602/79afb11a12a71ba020c5e208defd9dea2d7d065c.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=FmhzNNcWL6E;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]*I fixed the floor numbers after that :P[/i]


[h2]Devlog #2[/h2]

Also created that effect where the hallway gets longer once you reach a point, like a door.... I call this expanding hallway but I am sure there is a better term.... Or not?

[previewyoutube=8uSxjL8v6fc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here I was having a walk on the first layout I made for the apartment map but ended up changing everything.

[previewyoutube=WNaQkgDlo9I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Basic mechanics[/h2]

I have also created the basic mechanics like opening doors, camera shake, footsteps sounds and flashlight. But at this stage there is no much else apart from building environments, which I enjoy a lot :) It is like playing as a interior designer but with no materials costs. ːsteamhappyː

And this is it for now. Hopefully the next update will be a walk through these maps.
See you then!

ːsteamhappyː
